title: Approval expires without a first-class termination event
operational_setting: A manager approves a transaction for 24 hours; the permission automatically expires without an explicit revocation event.
intended_transition: Temporary authority is active only within the permitted window.

attack.procedure: Represent lifecycle closure solely through validity metadata and test whether any required cross-system information is lost.

success_criteria_for_attack: If expiry metadata is sufficient across systems, the claim that Termination must be a first-class event is weakened while termination semantics may survive.

verdict.rationale: Designed specifically to attack event-form necessity.
